## Acceptance evidence

| State | Required evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Local tests | command, result, commit |
| CI | workflow URL and head SHA |
| Deployment | exact artifact/image and target |
| Live functional verification | sanitized observation and checked time |

Unknown or unavailable evidence must remain `UNKNOWN`.
